|--------|----------|-----------|-------|

| Tuning Min | **0.431** | 0.051 | ⚠️ fragile |
| Lockbox Mean | 1.793 | **1.793** | ≈ |
| Lockbox Min | 1.134 | **1.347** | +18.8% |
| Worst MDD | **-9.3%** | -11.2% | worse |

## Status Summary

✅ **Champion stable** - v5_latest holding with balanced metrics  
⚠️ **Candidate trade-off** - macro_alpha_shadow has better lockbox floor but tuning fold fragility (min 0.05)  
🔄 **Loop healthy** - 174 iterations, ~30 hours remaining  

## Observations

1. **No promotion warranted** - candidate's tuning_min of 0.05 suggests overfitting risk despite lockbox improvement
2. **MDD discipline holding** - both under 12% threshold
3. **System exploring** - macro/alpha shadow direction shows promise on lockbox robustness

## Next Steps Ready
```bash
# Commands staged per handoff - ready to execute
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry ... --run --select-best
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec ... --run  
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry ... --output ...
```

Continue runloop. Monitor for candidates that improve lockbox_min while maintaining tuning_min > 0.3.
